history.summary: A 4BR subsale at Aurelle of Tampines, a fully-sold EC that TOPs in 2028, asking $1.8M ($1,760 psf). The launch sold out at an avg $1,766 psf, so this subsale is essentially flat to launch — the buyer captures no EC discount and inherits full ABSD/MOP-style timing risk before the post-MOP privatization upside.
history.rating_rationale: Aurelle launched and fully sold in 2025 at avg $1,766 psf; this $1,760 psf subsale prices in zero buffer versus the new-launch price already paid by first-hand buyers. ECs do appreciate strongly post-MOP, but as a resale buyer you pay near-launch PSF and wait through TOP (2028) + 5yr MOP with no rental income until completion. Pasir Ris MRT is 970m / 12 min. The thesis works only if EC PSF re-rates well above $1,766 by ~2033.
red_flags: Subsale at ~$1,760 psf vs $1,766 psf launch average — no EC entry discount captured
TOP only 2028; no rental income and capital locked until completion plus 5yr MOP
EC subsale buyers face eligibility/income-ceiling constraints, thinning the resale pool
970m from MRT in an OCR location
catalysts: EC post-MOP privatization premium (ECs historically re-rate up materially after 10 years)
Tampines/Pasir Ris regional growth, CRL connectivity

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: No rental until 2028 TOP, then strong family rental demand in Tampines but EC rental yields are typically modest. Not an income play.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: EC upside is real but back-loaded to post-MOP; entering at launch-equivalent PSF removes the usual EC bargain and pushes the payoff to 7+ years out.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_rate_source: EC post-MOP appreciation pattern, discounted for near-launch entry PSF
